第968章 宇宙群落、深渊爆发、危机-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
第968章 宇宙群落、深渊爆发、危机-《废土藏身处，从下水道开始升级》
“N78探索船........发现未知宇宙群落.......探查，触发.......防御……灾祸……迫降……”
“这艘飞船是从其他宇宙群落过来的？”这个想法立刻在于渊脑海浮现。
于渊最担心的就是无法吸收这艘飞船内的‘遗物’，毕竟如果它真是从其他宇宙群落闯进来的。
当即开始对所有‘遗物’进行全面吸收， 至于收容仓内的尸骸则埋葬于【神明禁区】，百分百回收再利用。
content_en:
Chapter 968: Cosmic community, abyss outbreak, crisis - "Wasteland hideout, upgrade from the sewer"
Chapter 968: Cosmic community, abyss outbreak, crisis - "Wasteland Hideout, Upgrade from the Sewer"
"N78 exploration ship...discovered unknown cosmic communities...explored, triggered...defense...disaster...crash landing..."
"Did this spaceship come from other universe communities?" This idea immediately appeared in Yu Yuan's mind.
What Yu Yuan is most worried about is that he cannot absorb the 'relics' in this spaceship, after all, if it really breaks in from other universe communities.
Immediately began to fully absorb all the 'relics'. As for the corpses in the storage warehouse, they were buried in the [God's Forbidden Zone] and 100% recycled.
